query: MATCH (d:Doc) RETURN d.title AS title, text_bm25(d, 'body', 'photosynthesis') AS lexical, vector_score(d, 'body_emb', [0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0]) AS semantic, score_fuse(text_bm25(d, 'body', 'photosynthesis'), vector_score(d, 'body_emb', [0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0])) AS fused ORDER BY fused DESC, title ASC LIMIT 5
